|combos=* [[U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio)]] + [[Program Trap]]<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json], U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio) (GEMP ID 2_107, commit d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab), records the three strategy combinations with Program Trap, Nevar Yalnal and E Chu Ta. These recommendations remain subject to each card's target and timing conditions. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20260422134639/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf 2023 Advanced Rulebook], p. 174, permits Effects on an undercover spy and, except during battle, permits Interrupts and cards targeting spies to target it. This supports Program Trap deployment, Nevar Yalnal when both players have a spy at the site, and E Chu Ta's protocol-droid insult outside battle; it does not assert that E Chu Ta's separate battle-initiation function uses an inactive undercover droid. The original U-3PO is a protocol droid and undercover spy. Page 155 separately confirms his power contribution without participation and Light's option to decline stealing him when cover breaks. The data record labels its 2023 wording revision a clarification with no gameplay change, not original printed wording. Preserved data copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183206/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive] (20 October 2026).
